Hi Kate, Rohit —

Thanks again for signing up for our evening group demo on May 12. We’ve had an unexpectedly high sign-up count for that slot and want to offer a smooth experience for everyone without making the session feel overcrowded. Proposed plan below — would love quick confirmation from your side on which track you prefer.

Option A (General): 30m — product overview + live walkthrough (recommended for exec/PM audience)
Option B (Deep dive): 45m — architecture, infra, inference cost/latency tuning (recommended for infra/ML teams)

Both tracks run in parallel at 6:00pm PT. We’ll also open a standby bridge (single Zoom bridge) at 5:50pm PT for overflow and recording only; hosts can pull people from the standby if space frees up. If you prefer, we can move Acme to Option A or B — which would you pick?

Logistics we’ll handle:
- Dedicated breakout links & recording per track
- Shared agenda doc + short pre-demo checklist
- Host assignment: Sofia (track A), Ben (track B), Marcus (overflow/QA)

Attachment: evening_group_demo_agenda_v2.pdf (agenda + talking points)

If I don’t hear back by EOD PT Friday I’ll default Acme to Option A.

Best,
Marcus Lin
